candidates.title: [RFC]: Lossless 12-bit storage for BF16 dense weights to speed up memory-bound decode
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  At small batch, decode is bound by memory bandwidth, so every byte of weights read per step costs time. Many low-bit checkpoints still keep their dense layers in BF16, including attention projections, linear-attention projections, the LM head and MTP heads.   NVFP4 MoE checkpoints are one example.
